Toronto Quayside (Sidewalk Labs) case: 12-acre site, 1,500-page master plan, ~C$1.3B planning cost, terminated May 2020; lesson on digital-first/over-commercialization.
Singapore Smart Nation case: launched 2014; Singpass digital identity ~97% eligible coverage, 5M users, >41M monthly transactions, 2,700+ services; public data foundation as first action.
London King's Cross Central case: 67-acre (c. 270,000 sqm) brownfield, c. £3B investment, c. 1,750 homes, 40% public space, Central Saint Martins relocated 2011; public-space-first station-city.
Tokyo Shibuya station-area regeneration: 9 rail lines integrated, ~3.3M daily passengers; Scramble Square 230m tower completed 2019; station as walkability and industry anchor.
